responsibility: Defines the data_structures module’s shared collection and utility surface for rustc_type_ir by selecting fast hash-based map/set aliases, index-preserving map/set aliases, re-exporting the delayed caching collections, and providing feature-gated implementations of small shared utilities such as stack growth support, reference-counted pointers, and small-string-optimized map/set stand-ins.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is not part of the solver pipeline at all: it is the crate’s shared utility entry point, assembling common hash/index collection aliases and feature-gated helpers (`Lrc`, stack support, small-map stand-ins) that the solver-oriented modules consume.
